data.narrative:
Terrahaptix is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Nathan Nwachukwu and Maxwell Maduka that has raised $52M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector companies at Seed and Series A stages, with market valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The broader comparables universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $52M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, yielding $130M. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set produces $700M, reflecting the wide dispersion in this sector (range: $125M–$4.0B). The peer group includes one Seed-stage company (UFORCE at $1.0B) and three Series A firms ($4.0B, $400M, $125M).

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $110M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $415M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty around stage-specific valuation multiples in an early-stage, capital-intensive defense tech sector. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, customer concentration (defense procurement), and the relevance of the high-outlier comps to Terrahaptix's specific technology and go-to-market position.
